# ClawQL documentation

> ClawQL provides the Agentic Gateway as the Foundational Platform for Auditable Production AI — OpenAPI/MCP search and execute, optional vault memory, Zero-Trust Agentic Fabric (Regional Hubs, Dedicated Virtual Gateways, Edge swarm), and defense-in-depth controls.

This file helps AI agents and crawlers find canonical documentation. For full-text Markdown of any page, send `Accept: text/markdown` on that URL.

## Getting started
- [Agent setup](https://docs.clawql.com/agent-setup): Desktop onboarding, Cursor iOS Cloud Agents, local sandbox
- [Inference setup](https://docs.clawql.com/getting-started/inference): clawql-inference five-minute start, BYOK, MCP + memory
- [Custom sources](https://docs.clawql.com/getting-started/custom-sources): Register other MCP servers into one gateway surface
- [Quickstart](https://docs.clawql.com/quickstart): Fastest path to a running gateway
- [Getting started](https://docs.clawql.com/getting-started): Quickstart paths, teams, and install options
- [Quickstart](https://docs.clawql.com/quickstart): npx, install options, and first MCP connect

## Core reference
- [MCP tools](https://docs.clawql.com/tools): search, execute, audit, cache, and optional tools
- [mcp-api-adapter](https://docs.clawql.com/mcp/mcp-api-adapter): Any MCP server → OpenAPI, GraphQL, /mcp, gRPC, /ws, gen-cli, /mcp-ui
- [mcp-ui](https://docs.clawql.com/mcp/mcp-ui): HTMX Swagger UI for MCP — seventh adapter surface, shipped
- [clawql-network](https://docs.clawql.com/specs/network/clawql-network): Headscale mesh + Tailcat ephemeral transport, selector, ATR audit
- [clawql-agents](https://docs.clawql.com/agents/clawql-agents): Seven open-source agent adapters with Panguard and WORM hooks
- [Zero-Trust Agentic Fabric](https://docs.clawql.com/architecture/agentic-fabric): Regional Hubs, Dedicated Virtual Gateways, Edge swarm
- [Enterprise Ontology](https://docs.clawql.com/architecture/enterprise-ontology): Open YAML/OKF typed entities, kinetic actions, Git vs R2
- [.cq* file extensions](https://docs.clawql.com/specs/cq-extensions): Draft specs for .cqe, .cqm, .cqk, .cqw (ADR 0010)
- [Token efficiency](https://docs.clawql.com/architecture/token-efficiency): Twelve compounding layers for cost and reasoning quality
- [Agentic Gateway (inference)](https://docs.clawql.com/inference/clawql-inference): OpenAI drop-in, flywheel, WORM path to Auditable Production AI
- [ClawQL Streams](https://docs.clawql.com/streams/clawql-streams): Event-driven autonomous agents — draft spec (WORM, NATS, DO/K8s)
- [Durable Objects runtime](https://docs.clawql.com/streams/clawql-durable-objects): Streams DO sidecars — audit, inference virtual keys, RTP/OBT
- [Plugins](https://docs.clawql.com/plugins): Searchable registry — horizontal plugins and domain verticals
- [Protocol](https://docs.clawql.com/reference/protocol): Uniform envelope and approval flows
- [Spec configuration](https://docs.clawql.com/spec-configuration): OpenAPI and provider sources

## Deployment & security
- [Deployment](https://docs.clawql.com/deployment): Docker, Kubernetes, and operations
- [Defense in depth](https://docs.clawql.com/security/defense-in-depth): Layered MCP security model
- [Security best practices](https://docs.clawql.com/security/best-practices): 32-module agentic AI security series
